# FG-REPO-0028

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 422 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_spec_lint_problem_fails_with_spec_lint_problem_and_an_annotation` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: このコミットの仕様の文書か @req の参照が規則に合っていません。forge/spec-lint の一覧のファイルと行を直してください。
- en: A specification document or @req reference at this commit breaks a rule. Fix the files and lines forge/spec-lint lists.
- id: Dokumen spesifikasi atau referensi @req pada commit ini melanggar aturan. Perbaiki berkas dan baris yang dicantumkan forge/spec-lint.

## 原因 (cause)

The check `forge/spec-lint` (M3 X4, plan 03 §5.4, ADR-0023 Amendment X4) indexed a merge request version's head: the Markdown files under the repository's own specification directories (its `.forge/repo.yml` `path:` entries, or `spec/`) and every `@req` tag of its tree. A rule is broken; the run concludes `failure` and its summary and annotations list each `path:line rule`. Document rules (forge_core::spec_doc): not_utf8, file_too_large (over 256 KiB: not read), front_matter_missing (requirement blocks without a front matter), front_matter_unclosed, front_matter_too_large, front_matter_syntax, front_matter_not_a_mapping, front_matter_duplicate_key, front_matter_multiple_documents, front_matter_yaml_feature (anchors, aliases, tags), front_matter_unknown_key (only spec / title / status / owners / confidential; in a plan 13 `doctype: spec.system` front matter — ADR-0026 §7, the older format's type, e.g. after `gstn doc fmt --migrate` — only the base keys: id is the name, retired makes it deprecated, classification is the mark; a document of another doctype is not indexed), spec_missing, spec_invalid, title_missing, title_invalid, status_missing, status_invalid (draft / review / approved / deprecated), owners_invalid (a list of at most 32 short texts), requirement_id_missing, requirement_id_invalid (upper-case letters and digits in two or more `-`-separated segments, first a letter, at most 64 bytes, never the `PBI` family), attribute_invalid (not key=value), attribute_unknown (only priority / status), attribute_duplicate, priority_invalid (must / should / could / wont), requirement_status_invalid (active / deprecated), block_nested (`::: req` inside a requirement), block_unclosed, close_unmatched (a `:::` with nothing open), body_empty, body_too_long (over 16 KiB), too_many_requirements (over 2000 in one file), too_deep (containers nested over 16). Index rules (forge_core::spec_index::lint): duplicate_id (an id defined twice; the detail names the first place), duplicate_spec (a `spec:` name used twice), broken_reference (a tag names an id of one of this repository's own families — the id without its last segment — that it does not define and no `repo:` entry's `scope:` covers). Not a server fault: the files are the repository's content. A block inside a fenced code block is never read.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

Open the run: gstn checks list --project <id> --sha <head> (forge/spec-lint; the summary lists every problem). The job's log event `forge.spec_index.recorded` carries `request_id`, `project_id`, `iid`, `head_sha`, both conclusions and the document and tag counts. Read the file at that commit (read-only): gstn browse blob --project <id> --ref <head> --path <path>, or check the whole index with gstn spec requirements --project <id> --ref <head>.

## 対処 (fix)

Correct the document or the tag at the listed line in the merge request. An id is never removed: mark it `status=deprecated` (plan 03 §4.2). Nothing to change on the server.
